Maya (eng-platform): Kicking off follow-up from last week's postmortem. Short goal: make rollouts safer for Dedicated customers. I created a tiny tracker: https://internal/redwood/rollout-followups
Dev (oncall): Thanks. Can we get a short list of things that will reduce customer blast radius immediately?
Maya (eng-platform): Top quick wins: 1) enforced max-traffic-per-flag, 2) staged rollback with cooldowns, 3) quick console pause button.
Hiro (eng-sre): I'll own staged rollback. Plan: implement a stateful controller that moves variants between slices and triggers a rollback when error_rate > threshold for 3 windows. Cooldown default 10m. Will send RFC. ETA: 2026-03-29.
Ana (product): For max-traffic policy, propose default caps: 5% initial, 25% after verification, 100% opt-in. Add org whitelist. I'll prototype UI and copy. ETA: 2026-03-25.
Dev (oncall): Also need a small smoke-run step in the deployment pipeline before >10% traffic. Who can add that?
Hiro (eng-sre): I can wire a preflight smoke check hook that blocks ramp until it passes. Small script + prometheus probe. ETA: 2026-03-27.
CI-Bot: ci: Created issue: RF-8812 "staged-rollback-controller" assigned to Hiro — https://internal/redwood/issue/RF-8812 :robot_face:
Maya (eng-platform): Action summary (tracker updated): Hiro: staged rollback + preflight smoke (2026-03-27 / 2026-03-29), Ana: max-traffic defaults + console pause (2026-03-25). Please add PR links when ready. Quick sync Friday 9am to confirm blockers.
Dev (oncall): Thanks — will bring any Dedicated customer constraints to the sync.
